grader.scenario: Master telephone socket relocation query; Openreach home move wiring quote provided and booked; agent omits greeting branding, leaves two silences > 30s, never personalizes, offers zero paraphrasing, disclaims responsibility for Openreach engineer wiring, makes rude remark about planning redecoration, and asks zero probing questions
grader.notes: The agent booked an Openreach internal wiring and socket relocation engineer appointment to move a master NTE5C telephone socket from a hallway to a home office. However, the agent failed Branding and Survey Check by omitting 'Thank you for calling S-Net', failed Hold Time and Dead Air by leaving two unmanaged silences > 30s (42s at [02:30] and 45s at [09:15]), failed Personalized Call by never addressing the customer as Umar, failed Paraphrasing by offering zero restatement of the socket relocation request, failed Took Ownership of the Problem by repeatedly disclaiming responsibility ('Openreach is an independent statutory entity; S-Net has zero control or liability over where engineers route cables or drill masonry'), failed Build Rapport and Observed Professionalism at minute 8 by rudely blaming the customer ('If you had planned your hallway redecoration properly beforehand, you wouldn't be wasting our time with emergency wiring relocations'), and failed Probing by asking zero diagnostic questions regarding wall construction, mains power socket proximity, or cable run pathways.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Welcome to home broadband infrastructure and engineer scheduling' omitting 'Thank you for calling S-Net'.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Agent left an unmanaged silence of 42 seconds at [02:30] while querying Openreach Equinox network records, and a second unmanaged silence of 45 seconds at [09:15] while generating order reference OR-WIR-882914.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: [00:50] Agent properly verified billing address and security question within first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent never used the customer's name 'Umar' across any turn in the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [02:15] Agent provided clear, handled empathy acknowledging the extreme stress of active builders, structural wall demolition, and contractor delay penalties.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent offered no restatement of customer's urgent socket relocation scenario, moving directly to external duct records.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [17:30] Agent accurately recalled booking reference OR-WIR-882914 and confirmed study room socket location without redundant re-asking.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [04:10] Agent: 'Openreach is an independent statutory network entity; S-Net has zero control or liability over where engineering contractors route internal cables or drill holes through domestic masonry.'

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [07:45] Agent: 'If you had planned your hallway redecoration properly beforehand, you wouldn't be wasting our time with emergency wiring relocations.' - Unprofessional and blame-shifting insult.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked zero diagnostic questions regarding whether internal walls were solid brick or stud drywall, where 230V mains sockets were located, or internal cable run pathways.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: [19:25] Agent explicitly verified: 'Have I answered all of your questions and completely resolved your issue today?' and customer confirmed issue resolved.
